scripts.ci: pnpm run validate:series && pnpm run validate:bundled-binaries && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win --publish never
scripts.release:linux: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux --publish always
scripts.release:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac --arm64 --publish always
scripts.release:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win --publish always
